title: A self-healing non-precious metal oxide anode in proton exchange membrane electrolysis beyond 1000 h stability at 2 A cm−2
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9183-9193
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02703A, Paper
Miao Yu Lin, Wen Jing Li, Hao Yang Lin, Sheng Dai, Zhen Xin Lou, Jia Chen Wu, Huai Qin Fu, Song Ru Fang, Hao Fan, Xiao Xiao Mao, Xue Qing Chen, Hai Yang Yuan, Peng Fei Liu, Hua Gui Yang, Yu Hou
This work demonstrates the dissolution–redeposition dynamic equilibrium of non-precious metal anode catalysts under PEMWE conditions, establishing stable active sites and achieving unprecedented long-term stability at ultrahigh current densities.
